title: Spectrum of a ring with all primes maximal
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring such that every prime ideal of $A$ is maximal. Then $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], in its Zariski topology, is compact Hausdorff and totally disconnected (that is, profinite).
